Observations / day analysis

  • Source-side throughout: every loss segment is explained by the selected source going silent (both encoder thumbnails standby, PTZ standby banners, zero switch correlation, recoveries matching source wake-ups). No segment needs a decoder-fault hypothesis; every decoder re-locked automatically when its source returned.
  • Saturday shape — morning saves, evening terminations: the morning second wave all recovered in time for their classes (10:00 / 12:00) except Room 07; from 16:18 five rooms terminated their sources and none recovered, so all four evening-class rooms (02/03/07/08) stayed dark to day end — the reverse of the usual pre-class recovery pattern.
  • Recurrence ranking: Room 07 busiest (long in-class outage + two USB/vhub clusters + full evening session dark + day-end storm); Room 02 next (mid-class cluster, DEC-2 dark all evening, DEC-1 three storms + No-space + buffer stall); Room 06 longest stop but no classes; Rooms 03/05 one long stop each.
  • Coverage & evidence quality: 240/240 readable for the third consecutive day. Only gaps: Room 1 satellite buffer returned 1 line tonight, and Room 02 DEC-1's log stall after 21:32 (its standby state corroborated by thumbnails).
